_schema.description: Single source of truth for every physical constant in the hexapod model. Nothing in core/, bindings/, sim/ or tests/ may hard-code a value that appears here.

status_meanings.decided: Fixed by a numbered decision or a vendor specification. Changes only by a new decision.
status_meanings.measured: Produced by a hardware-workstream measurement campaign. Carries an uncertainty.
status_meanings.provisional: A working number standing in for a measurement that has not happened. Will change.
status_meanings.unspecified: No authoritative value exists yet. Reading this raises ConstantError by design.
status_meanings.surrogate: No measurement exists. This number exists ONLY so that code can run. It carries no claim about the physical machine. Any output derived from it must be stamped with the surrogates that fed it.

_schema.precision_convention: D147 - double precision throughout, no intermediate rounding. Angles 4 dp in degrees, lengths 4 dp in millimetres.

consumers.sim/constants.py: double precision -> derive, sweep, the fourteen outputs, emitted tables
consumers.the caller -> hex_config_t: float -> ik_core, gait_core on the 50 Hz path

controlled_dof_per_leg.note: Coxa yaw + femur pitch actuated. The tibia member is installed and held at fixed theta_3_deg. v2 makes theta_3 a solve variable with no interface change (PROJECT_02 §2).

servo_count_installed.note: 18 x ZX20D serial bus servos, 3 per leg. 12 actuated, 6 held at theta_3.

coxa_length_mm.note: L1. PROJECT_02 §3 declares L2 and L3 unknown until measured but is silent on L1. QUESTION RAISED WITH COORDINATION: is L1 also unknown? Treated as surrogate until ruled.

femur_length_mm.note: L2. PROJECT_02 §3: frame's femur member, unknown until measured. The old 90.0 mm was derived for a frame that no longer exists; it survives here only as a number that lets code run.

tibia_length_mm.note: L3. Frame's tibia member, unknown until measured. Surrogate equal to the femur surrogate purely so that the two are visibly arbitrary and neither looks measured.

theta_3_deg.note:
Fixed tibia angle. PROJECT_02 §2 requires a configuration field with a default, NOT an absent joint and NOT a hard-coded zero.
THE SURROGATE IS DELIBERATELY NON-ZERO. psi = atan2(L3*sin(theta3), L2 + L3*cos(theta3)) is zero whenever theta3 is zero, whatever L2 and L3 are. A zero surrogate therefore collapses the three-member leg onto the legacy two-member case in every test that uses this table, hiding the theta2-vs-Theta distinction the algorithm workstream names as the single most likely error in the sweep runner. -30.0 is arbitrary and claims nothing; it exists so the psi path is exercised. Replace on measurement.

theta_2_neutral_deg.note: Femur pitch at mid-stance. A solve variable with a floor, not a free choice.

coxa_positions_mm.note: SUPERSEDED IN PRINCIPLE. PROJECT_04 §2 states this table was derived for a body plate that no longer exists. Awaiting measurement of the Yeahbot frame. Two open questions raised with coordination: (a) 56.57 is given to 2 dp but D147 requires 4 dp; if the intent is 80/sqrt(2) the value is 56.5685. (b) whether the Yeahbot frame is even hexagonal in this arrangement.

leg_neutral_direction_deg.note: Lateral neutral. beta_mount and beta_neutral stay separate (D23) - this table is beta_neutral only.

body_bob_budget_mm.note: Peak-to-peak. This, not servo torque, is what limits stride.

swing_velocity_profile.note: The peak/mean ratio of pi/2 is DELIBERATELY NOT STORED HERE. It is a consequence of the profile and must be computed. Storing it would be the exact failure the hard-coded-constant guard exists to catch.

command_step_deg.note: Per bus command. Supersedes 0.4392 deg per PCA9685 count. Third member of the hard-coded-constant guard (PROJECT_04 §4).

servo_speed_no_load_deg_s.note: Vendor no-load figure. Supersedes the provisional 200 deg/s.

servo_speed_loaded_deg_s.source: PROJECT_04 §2 - to be measured by the hardware workstream.
servo_speed_loaded_deg_s.note: MP2 deliverable. Any timing claim that needs a loaded speed must fail loudly until this exists.

payload_mass_kg.note: Unweighed. The mass PROJECT_04 §2's a_eff figure was quoted at.

members_per_leg.note: Coxa, femur, tibia. Mechanically three-segment, kinematically two-DOF.

torque_margin.note: hex_config.h calls this margin_factor and rejects margin_factor < 1, so it is a DIVISOR on the available torque, not a multiplier - the invariant is tau_peak * margin_factor <= tau_servo_kgcm. The 21 Aug note to coordination framed it as a multiplier; that framing is withdrawn. Algorithm WS §4: leave unset rather than guessing, because a wrong surrogate that quietly passes is worse than a missing one that fails validation.

_expectations._note: Predicted OUTPUTS from PROJECT_02 §3, for validation only. Loading these as inputs is a test failure. Every figure is unmeasured.

beta_mount_deg.source: hex_config.h, D23, D24, D25 - no value has been issued
beta_mount_deg.note: Frame yaw of each coxa axis, six values. D23 keeps this SEPARATE from beta_neutral_deg. Setting it equal to beta_neutral is exactly the D23 error, so no surrogate is offered here. The fourteen sweep outputs do not use it; only the body<->leg transform does.

dtheta_peak_deg_s.note: Peak joint rate the swing profile is scaled to. The no-load figure standing in for a loaded one. Sweep outputs 12-14 scale linearly with this, so it is emitted alongside them (D62) and the ratios across duty are what survive, not the absolutes.

joint_min_deg.source: hex_config.h - ZX20D travel limits not issued

joint_max_deg.source: hex_config.h - ZX20D travel limits not issued

stale_ramp_ms.source: hex_config.h, D144 - needed by gait_core, due 30 Sep

swing_eps_mm_s.source: hex_config.h, D144 - needed by gait_core, due 30 Sep
